function.name: send_channel_message
function.description: Post the meeting summary to a Microsoft Teams channel via webhook. Call this once per meeting with the full formatted summary.

title.description: Short meeting title, e.g. 'Sprint planning – 10 Jun 2025'

summary.description: 3-5 sentence plain-English summary of what was discussed and decided

attendees.description: Names or roles mentioned in the transcript as present

decisions.description: Explicit decisions made during the meeting, one per entry

next_meeting.description: Next meeting date/time if mentioned, otherwise omit

function.name: wit_create_work_item
function.description: Create a single work item in Azure DevOps. Call once per action item — do not batch.

type.description: Work item type: Task, Bug, User Story, or Feature

title.description: Concise title under 80 chars, starting with a verb

assigned_to.description: Name or email of assignee as mentioned in transcript. Omit if not specified.

area_path.description: ADO area path if identifiable. Omit if unclear.
